source.author: stat
source.text: it maestus genua aegra trahens hastamque sequentem, vulneribus ceu mille gravis totosque per artus saucius, absistunt socii monstrantque gementes.
source.text_original: it maestus genua aegra trahens hastamque sequentem, / vulneribus ceu mille gravis totosque per artus / saucius, absistunt socii monstrantque gementes.
source.text_english: He goes on, dragging his sickened knees and the spear following after him, heavy with a thousand wounds as though, and wounded through all his limbs; his comrades step aside and, groaning, point him out.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: unde urna umeris niveosque per artus caeruleae vestes?
reuse.text_original: unde urna umeris niveosque per artus / caeruleae vestes?
reuse.text_english: Whence the urn on their shoulders and the blue garments over their snowy limbs?
